upperObserverContract.measuredForceSource: Explicit connection from local Contact force reconstruction/Cell error to deviation; acquired axial B-S deltaL
upperObserverContract.causality: Explicit local acquired axial cell deviation, existing S acceleration, S-A position and already-issued robot prediction. No actual A/current/actuator-force/surface truth. No extra force acquisition/pipeline, equilibrium holding-force subtraction or guide-friction subtraction.
upperObserverContract.predictorLimitation: Force-balance differentiation is properly regularized; it amplifies acquired cell noise and is approximate above the regularization band. It estimates net physical actuator force including actual drive clipping and guide friction.

liveLocalSignalGuard.source: Actual installed Contact force reconstruction/Cell error to deviation output via explicit subsystem connection
liveLocalSignalGuard.selectedSink: Actual installed Head motion estimator/Cell force deviation from equilibrium driving observer
liveLocalSignalGuard.scope: Temporary raw acquired-cell-error injection verifies active source/sign and zero equilibrium, then restores every original model connection before native export. These tiny wiring-harness runs are excluded from physical force qualification.

cellModalContract.source: Actual acquired local axial cell deltaL; unique explicitly GLOBAL tag from Cell error to deviation
cellModalContract.currentPlacement: After baseline notch, before original current limit
cellModalContract.antiwindupReference: Total notched baseline plus modal current before limit
cellModalContract.phaseDesign: Exact-ZOH resonant bandpass and proper derivative basis, solved at identified carrier using native sine-measured acquisition transfer,50uscurrentlag and10kcommandhold
cellModalContract.causality: Two stable native discrete states driven by existing acquired cell history only. No measured physical current, plant truth, surface profile, future command, extra sensor or retimed reconstruction.
cellModalContract.scope: Controller creates active virtual damping; physical external damping, stiffness, friction and all sensor noise remain unchanged. Carrier phase matching is a finite identified model design, not broadband/hardware robustness proof.

nativePositiveDampingGuard.scope: Native raw-cell acquisition, digital modal output,10k command hold and actual50us current response checked end-to-end at carrier. Physical current is a diagnostic log only, never a controller input. Baseline current held at loaded equilibrium; no candidate noise change. Harnesses excluded from force qualification.

accelerationLeadContract.discretization: Bilinear at fresh 10 kHz force frame

guideFeedforwardContract.soleBlock: Measured motion feedforward/Guide friction velocity scale

causalContract: Observations use measured/estimated signals and actual already-issued commands only. Truth and disconnected baseline actions are separate scoring/comparator outputs. Actor current replaces baseline PI/FF actuation before its notch; bounded causal modal feedback remains after notch and before limits, so baseline current comparator excludes the modal overlay; actor robot correction is 100Hz held and passes original gate and teacher sign/amplitude envelope.
